summary: This directory provides a collection of standardized form input components built upon Material UI. It centralizes custom wrappers, configurations, and specialized field implementations to ensure consistent project-specific behavior, styling, and functionality across all user input elements.
responsibilities: Provide customized versions of Material UI input components
Encapsulate consistent project-specific styling and tooltips
Standardize property interfaces for form fields
Manage read-only states and layout defaults for input elements
relationships: The directory wraps standard Material UI components to inject project-specific properties and styling requirements.
Component wrappers integrate shared helper components like tooltips and labels to maintain a uniform look and feel across all inputs.
designDecisions: Adapter pattern used to standardize third-party Material UI components to project requirements
Centralized configuration for common UI features like labels and tooltips
Composition of base components into specialized form fields
